verdicts.reasoning: The items explicitly ask the student to compare two fractions by providing the correct relational sign. For example, seed 64 asks 'Which sign makes the statement true: 1/4 ___ 1/2?' and provides comparison operators as options.
Every comparison problem in these seeds involves the fraction 1/2 as one of the operands, such as comparing '1/4 ___ 1/2' in seed 78.
Every comparison problem in these seeds involves the fraction 1/4 as one of the operands, paired against 1/2.

Only seeds 23, 103, and 127 actually include a visual 'FractionModel' payload to support the comparison. The other seeds instruct the user to 'Look at the fraction models' but fail to render any visual payload. Even the ones that do render a payload only supply a single fraction model instead of two.
verdicts.content_note_from_attester: Many seeds (e.g., 11, 42, 57, 64) prompt the user to 'Look at the fraction models' or 'shaded models' but do not provide any visual payload.
